question: What is the filing deadline for employment tax?

consequentialClaims.text: File Form 941 if you paid wages subject to employment taxes with the IRS for each quarter by the last day of the month that follows the end of the quarter. If you timely deposited all taxes when due, then you have 10 additional calendar days to file the return.
